001import java.net.URI;
002import java.util.Deque;
003import java.util.LinkedList;
004
005/**
006 * purchaseQueue - handles the queue of songs that have been purchased
007 * Only lets you add songs if you have enough money
008 * 
009 * @author Joel Cipher
010 * @version 1.0
011 */
012public class purchaseQueue {
013    
014    // using Deque like the project spec recommended
015    private Deque<QueuedSong> queue;
016    
017    private SongList songList;
018    private balanceBox balance;
019
020    private String currentlyPlayingSongName;
021    
022    /**
023     * Holds info about a song in the queue
024     */
025    private class QueuedSong {
026        String title;
027        String artist;
028        double cost;
029        int songIndex;
030        
031        /**
032         * Creates a queued song
033         */
034        QueuedSong(String title, String artist, double cost, int songIndex) {
035            this.title = title;
036            this.artist = artist;
037            this.cost = cost;
038            this.songIndex = songIndex;
039        }
040    }
041    
042    /**
043     * Sets up the queue
044     * @param songList the list of available songs
045     * @param balance the balance tracker
046     */
047    public purchaseQueue(SongList songList, balanceBox balance) {
048        this.queue = new LinkedList<QueuedSong>();
049        this.songList = songList;
050        this.balance = balance;
051    }
052
053    String getPlayingSongName(){
054        return currentlyPlayingSongName;
055    }
056// For testing purposes, add song without testing balance.
057    Boolean addSongForFree(int songIndex) {
058        String[][] songArray = songList.getSongArray();
059        
060        // check if the song number is valid
061        if (songIndex < 0 || songIndex >= songArray.length) {
062            System.out.println("Error: invalid song number");
063            return false;
064        }
065        
066        // get song details from the array
067        String title = songArray[songIndex][0];
068        String artist = songArray[songIndex][1];
069        double cost = Double.parseDouble(songArray[songIndex][2]);
070        
071        // add the song to end of queue
072        QueuedSong song = new QueuedSong(title, artist, cost, songIndex);
073        queue.addLast(song);
074        
075        System.out.println("Added to queue: " + title + " by " + artist + " ($" + cost + ")");
076        return true;
077    }
078
079
080    /**
081     * Adds a song to the queue if there's enough money
082     * @param songIndex which song to add (starts at 0)
083     * @param addFrontTrue wether the song should be added to front or back of queue
084     * @return true if added, false if not enough funds or bad index
085     */
086    public boolean addSong(int songIndex, boolean addFrontTrue) {
087        String[][] songArray = songList.getSongArray();
088        
089        // check if the song number is valid
090        if (songIndex < 0 || songIndex >= songArray.length) {
091            System.out.println("Error: invalid song number");
092            return false;
093        }
094        
095        // get song details from the array
096        String title = songArray[songIndex][0];
097        String artist = songArray[songIndex][1];
098        double cost = Double.parseDouble(songArray[songIndex][2]);
099        
100        // NOTE: balance uses cents so need to convert
101        int costInCents = (int)(cost * 100);
102        
103        if (addFrontTrue){
104            costInCents += 50;
105        }
106        // try to deduct the cost
107        if (!balance.deductFunds(costInCents)) {
108            System.out.println("Not enough money to buy: " + title);
109            return false;
110        }
111        
112        // add the song to end of queue
113        QueuedSong song = new QueuedSong(title, artist, cost, songIndex);
114        if (addFrontTrue){
115            queue.addFirst(song);
116        }else{
117            queue.addLast(song);
118        }
119        
120        
121        System.out.println("Added to queue: " + title + " by " + artist + " ($" + cost + ")");
122        return true;
123    }
124
125    
126    
127    /**
128     * Removes a song from the queue at a specific position
129     * @param index position in queue (0 = first song)
130     * @return true if removed, false if bad index
131     */
132    public boolean removeSong(int index) {
133        if (index < 0 || index >= queue.size()) {
134            System.out.println("Error: invalid queue position");
135            return false;
136        }
137        
138        // had to convert to array to get by index since Deque doesn't have get()
139        QueuedSong[] queueArray = queue.toArray(new QueuedSong[0]);
140        QueuedSong removed = queueArray[index];
141        
142        queue.remove(removed);
143        
144        System.out.println("Removed from queue: " + removed.title + " by " + removed.artist);
145        return true;
146    }
147    
148    /**
149     * Gets the next song to play and removes it from queue
150     * @return URI of next song, or null if queue empty
151     */
152    public URI nextSong() {
153        // check if queue is empty
154        if (queue.size() == 0) {
155            System.out.println("Queue is empty.");
156            return null;
157        }
158        
159        // take first song off the queue
160        QueuedSong nextSong = queue.removeFirst();
161        
162        // get the URI for this song
163        URI songURI = songList.getSongURI(nextSong.songIndex);
164        
165        currentlyPlayingSongName = nextSong.title;
166
167        System.out.println("Now playing: " + nextSong.title + " by " + nextSong.artist);
168        return songURI;
169    }
170    
171    
172    /**
173     * Shows all songs in the queue
174     * @return string with all queued songs
175     */
176    public String displayQueue() {
177        if (queue.size() == 0) {
178            return "Queue is empty.";
179        }
180        
181        String result = "=== Current Queue ===\n";
182        
183        int position = 1;
184        // loop through all songs in queue
185        for (QueuedSong song : queue) {
186            result = result + position + ". " + song.title + " by " + song.artist + 
187                     " ($" + song.cost + ")\n";
188            position++;
189        }
190        
191        return result;
192    }
193    
194    /**
195     * Gets how many songs are in the queue
196     * @return number of songs
197     */
198    public int getQueueSize() {
199        return queue.size();
200    }
201    
202    /**
203     * Returns any leftover money
204     * @return refund message
205     */
206    public String refund() {
207        return balance.returnFunds();
208    }
209}
210
